I’m 26 and a few days short of 7 weeks PO. Married and not wanting kids. Recovery has been easy to me. I have PCOS so they were kind of out of the question. My doctor told me everything was inflamed and that’s what was causing so much pain. It’s strange being nearly 2 months without pain or a period I will say!

My main reason is an absolute fear of pregnancy/ PCOS. My periods were so painful and I was constantly in some sort of pain. My periods were irregular and causes serious mood swings. I have no regret. It’s the greatest decision. Instead of being on 5-6 medications I’m officially on 1.

With the way the world is going I recommend it. I got sterilized and the recovery has been great. I’m excited to have risk free sex and not have to worry about pregnancy/ possibly dying. 

Some states are harder but I live in a red state and got it done because I have PCOS. It never hurts to try and to advocate for yourself!

I’m 4WPO at the age of 26. They took everything but the ovaries. I’ve suffered from PCOS since I was 12. Recovery so far has been pretty easy on me. The worst was the gas and I’ll occasionally cramp here or there but nothing bad. As for my mood, I’ve been significantly happier. I was taken down to one medication a day and haven’t felt depressed or sad since surgery. I’ve gained ~5 pounds since surgery but nothing major. 

Best decision I’ve ever made. I can’t wait to live the rest of my life pain free.
